title: Smith Predictor Controller
text: Discrete-time Smith dead-time compensator, 3 inputs, 1 output; {Proportional gain} sets the k p, {Integral gain} sets the k i, {Integrator initial condition} sets the initial integrator value, {Control action upper limit} sets the u max, {Control action lower limit} sets the u min, {Model discrete transfer function numerator} sets the transfer function numerator, {Model discrete transfer function denominator} sets the transfer function denominator, {System dead time (samples)} sets the number of dead-time samples and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the sampling interval. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Control action upper limit
params.values: u max 5 (default) | scalar greater than the value of the Control action lower limit parameter

params.name: Model discrete transfer function numerator
params.values: Transfer function numerator 1 (default) | scalar or vector

params.name: System dead time (samples)
params.values: Number of dead-time samples 2 (default) | 0 or a positive integer

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Sampling interval -1 (default) | default value or a positive number
